title: A Recognizable Substitution for the Anti-Penrose Tiling
summary: We present a substitution on six marked rhombs, called Seabed, with inflation factor $\varphi^3$. We prove that its tiling space is mutually locally derivable with the unmarked Anti-Penrose pentagrid hull. Eleven vertex patches of depth at most four recognize the parent vertices: their acceptance domains coincide with the five internally contracted windows. Matching the fine tiles around each parent rhomb to a replacement patch recovers their markings uniquely.
